title: God Rescues You
truth: God loves to help us when we are in trouble, and He is always strong enough to do it.
points: God is always there for you.
He wants to help you when things are hard.
He is powerful enough to deliver you.
apply: When you have a problem today, big or small, talk to God about it. Ask Him to help you.
prayer: God, thank You for always being there to rescue me when I am in trouble. I love You.
